Welcome to the introduction to omics with R — part of a series of hands-on bioinformatics
training workshops. Each workshop is a self-contained, roughly two-hour
session; they don't depend on each other, so take them in whatever order
suits you.

## Workshops

### [Foundations of R with the Tidyverse](r_tidyverse_workshop.html)

Covers R basics (objects, data types, vectors) and the dplyr core verbs
(`filter`, `select`, `mutate`, `arrange`, `summarize`), group operations, and
a first `ggplot2` plot — using the built-in `starwars` dataset.

### [RNA-seq and Transcriptomics](rnaseq_workshop.html)

Covers RNA-seq experimental design, the analysis workflow from raw reads to
a differential expression results table, and interpreting DESeq2 output.
